newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 25.83 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 25.83 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate (TIIE) rose by 33 basis points to 25.83 percent on Wednesday, from 25.50 percent on Tuesday, Banco de Mexico said.
The TIIP meanwhile rose 69.04 percentage points to 25.8740 percent on Wednesday from 25.1836 percent the week before.
The 91-day TIIE rose 35 percentage points to 25.25 percent on Wednesday from 24.90 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
